verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch operation capability, such as a batch API, bulk update, or multi-item action. The nearest item is scheduled Portfolio workflows (alloy-docs-15), but that is a recurring scheduled evaluation and the evidence never says it acts on many items at once by user request. That makes it an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
